_README: Which run directory is canonical for each (arm, dataset, model). Analysis must
read this instead of guessing from directory names -- the names do not encode
the teacher, the protocol, or whether a cell was superseded, and picking by
name has produced wrong comparisons.
- A cell under 'superseded' is never used in a comparison.
- 'replicates' are independent draws of the SAME condition, on arms whose
evidence is drawn: random_k (new generator pairs) and the active arms (the
model's own queries). Report their mean and spread; never pair a replicate
against a different condition.
- 'repeated_runs' are reruns on FIXED evidence: static (authored pairs) and
teacher-taught cells (one fixed demo set). Nothing is drawn, so they are
not draws; they isolate the model's inherent run-to-run fluctuation.
Report their mean, and their spread as that fluctuation.
- seed is a label only. It selects which frozen item file is read; it does not
control the generator draw on P-ARC or ConceptARC, so two runs at one seed
differ as much as two runs at different seeds.
- 'pair_halves' are the _samp halves of unbranched runs: half a draw each,
combined with their main run. Filter them AFTER pairing, never before.
- P-ARC / gpt-6-astra reports TWO draws per arm. Third draws exist on disk
for random_k and active_forced_k and are excluded by decision.
- 'exclusion_rules' apply BEFORE anything else here. A run marked
INVALID_shared_test_context.json is out of every per-item figure.

static.note: br_s1 relabelled to seed 0; its sampled items come from parc_seed1.json -- verify against that file.

random_k.note: randK_parc50_astra is unbranched; its sampled half is randK_parc50_astra_samp and must be combined for a per-item figure.

active_forced_k.note: draws 1 and 2, chronological. s0_b_rep2 is a third draw, excluded by decision 2026-09-21.

random_k.note: randK_parc50_g38 pairs with randK_parc50_g38_samp for a per-item figure.
randK_parc50_luna pairs with randK_parc50_luna_samp for a per-item figure.

superseded.randK_parc50_astra_br_s1: seed 1; excluded from the astra P-ARC comparison by decision 2026-09-20
superseded.randK_arc400_astra_br_s1: seed 1; 369/400 failed on the 31-item arc_seed1.json. Replaced by randK_arc400_astra_br_rep2 at seed 0.
superseded.randK_parc50_astra_br_rep2: third draw, excluded by decision 2026-09-21. Also redundant: the cell already had two draws and the run should not have been launched.
superseded.sciK_parc50_astra_s0_b_rep2: third draw, excluded by decision 2026-09-21. P-ARC astra reports draws 1+2 only.

auxiliary.static_parc50_g38_br_rep2: auxiliary; excluded from canonical gemini P-ARC static unless explicitly requested
auxiliary.static_parc50_luna_br_rep2: auxiliary; excluded from canonical luna P-ARC static unless explicitly requested
auxiliary._rule: Auxiliary cells are valid runs held out of the canonical set by decision. Never include them in a reported figure unless the user asks for them by name.

pair_halves._rule: Sampled halves of an unbranched random-K run. Each is HALF a draw: combine it with the main run of the same name to get one draw covering both test kinds. Never use one standalone, and never list one under 'superseded' -- a coverage script that filters superseded before pairing then loses the main run's partner and reports the cell as unreplicated. That miscount cost one redundant $10 run on 2026-09-21.

exclusion_rules.shared_test_context: A run directory holding INVALID_shared_test_context.json answered all of a trial's held-out items in ONE call, so each answer saw the other items' grids. Its per-item numbers are not independent measurements and must never enter a per-item accuracy. Only the joint all-items-correct field stays valid. Check for this marker file, not just this JSON -- the marker is the source of truth and lives beside the run.
exclusion_rules.incomplete: Require >=99% of the manifest's limit. A 90% threshold admits a run that is still writing records and reports it as a finished draw.
exclusion_rules.conceptarc_extra50: ConceptARC analysis uses the STANDARD 160 tasks only: the runner's own list (pipelines.run_active_arc_batch._task_ids, dataset=conceptarc, per_concept_limit=10). Some older runs also hold 50 extra synthetic tasks (index 11-15 in 10 concepts; ids in experiments/conceptarc_extra50_task_ids.json). Drop those records from every normal ConceptARC figure -- they are a separate analysis. Six older runs (sciK_ca160_astra_s0, sci_ca160_astra_s0_v2, sci_ca160_g38_s0, sci_ca160_luna_s0_v2, static_ca160_astra_v2, static_ca160_g38, static_ca160_luna_v2) cover only 110 of the standard 160 and fail the 'incomplete' rule for standard analysis.
exclusion_rules.empty_teacher_set: A teacher-taught record with error 'empty teacher set' means the teacher produced zero demonstrations for that task (e.g. hit max_turns without showing any). It is the teacher failing to teach, not an API failure: count it as INCORRECT for the student and keep it in the denominator. Never re-run it and never drop it. Decided 2026-09-22.
